title: Large-Scale Gaussian Splatting with a Multi-GPU PyTorch Backend
abstract: arXiv:2606.11390v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Gaussian splatting methods have become increasingly popular for neural reconstruction of the real world. However, they are often limited in scale and resolution due to compute and memory constraints. We present a multi-GPU Gaussian splatting approach that scales reconstruction to higher resolutions and larger scenes while abstracting away the code complexity typically associated with distributing a model. We demonstrate city-scale reconstructions with street-level detail consisting of over 1 billion Gaussian splats. To accomplish this, we propose a PyTorch backend that distributes parameters and operators across GPUs via CUDA unified memory, with optional NVLink support. Because distribution occurs at the operator level, the model code requires no explicit cross-device communication. More broadly, the backend exposes multiple GPUs as an aggregate asynchronous PyTorch device and supports a broad set of PyTorch operators enabling

translated_title: 基于多GPU PyTorch后端的大规模高斯泼溅
translated_abstract: 高斯泼溅方法在真实世界的神经重建中日益流行。然而，由于计算和内存的限制，它们在规模和分辨率上往往受到约束。我们提出了一种多GPU高斯泼溅方法，能够将重建扩展到更高的分辨率和更大的场景，同时抽象掉了通常与模型分布式部署相关的代码复杂性。我们展示了具有街道级细节的城市规模重建，包含超过10亿个高斯泼溅点。为实现这一目标，我们提出了一个PyTorch后端，通过CUDA统一内存（并可选支持NVLink）在多个GPU之间分发参数和算子。由于分发发生在算子层面，模型代码无需任何显式的跨设备通信。更广泛地说，该后端将多个GPU暴露为一个聚合的异步PyTorch设备，并支持广泛的PyTorch算子集合，从而……
tldr: 该论文提出基于CUDA统一内存的多GPU PyTorch后端，使高斯泼溅重建可扩展至超过10亿个高斯点的城市规模，且模型代码无需显式跨设备通信。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-GPU PyTorch backend built on CUDA unified memory that scales Gaussian splatting reconstruction to city scale with over 1 billion splats, requiring no explicit cross-device communication in model code.
